implementation.pngWalk: After the 8-byte signature, every chunk is walked. length/type/data/CRC must lie inside the file before any offset advances; a length above the PNG maximum 0x7fffffff is refused immediately. Chunk CRC-32 is computed over chunk type+data with the reflected polynomial 0xedb88320 and initial/final inversion (PNG specification, ISO/IEC 15948 §5.5 CRC-32, ISO 3309/ITU-T V.42), and compared with the stored CRC. IHDR must be the first chunk with length 13 and must match the parsed dimensions; IDAT must exist and be consecutive; IEND must have length 0 and end exactly at EOF; bytes after IEND are refused.
implementation.gifWalk: 13-byte logical screen descriptor, global color table from the packed field, then extensions (0x21 label + sub-blocks), image descriptors (0x2c + 9 bytes + optional local color table + LZW minimum code size + sub-blocks) and the 0x3b trailer. Every declared sub-block length is compared with the remaining bytes before advancing; unknown markers, EOF, missing trailer and bytes after the trailer are refused. LZW data is never decoded and pixel counts are not checked.
implementation.reportAdditions: structureVerified (boolean) and structure details: PNG chunkCount, idatChunkCount, crcVerified, iendAtEnd; GIF imageDescriptorCount, extensionCount, subBlockCount, globalColorTableBytes, localColorTableCount, trailerAtEnd. imageDescriptorCount is a structural block count, not drawable/decoded frame count; frameCountVerified remains false and its meaning is unchanged. identityVerified, containerHeaderVerified, unsupported handling and exit codes are unchanged.
implementation.ordering: Identity mismatch and header/resolution mismatch keep their existing status 'mismatch' and return before the structure walk, so existing behavior is preserved. With a correctly recomputed manifest identity the structure walk runs and a malformed container returns status 'invalid'.
